notes.title: Gym Manager - full game released!
notes.content:
[h1][b]🌟 Hey Gym Managers! 🌟[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]It's time for the grand opening! Gym Manager is live, and from today, you can dive into the world of managing your own gym! 🏋️‍♂️✨

Build, expand, and manage your fitness empire. Ready to become the best manager in town? Exciting challenges and loads of fun await you![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798396/7ba8f9bcf49270a1dc14bba57481963eeeea56d6.png[/img]

[b]We want to hear your suggestions, opinions, requests, and any other ideas. Your feedback is incredibly important to us and will help make Gym Manager even better![/b]

So, what are you waiting for? Jump into the game today and show us what you’ve got! 💪See you at the gym!

[b]If you're interested in other games in a similar climate, don't forget to check out the Bundle deals! [/b]

notes.title: Gym Manager: Prologue - is now available to play!
notes.content:
[b]We are happy to announce that the Gym Manager: Prologue is now available to play for free for everyone![/b] 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902070/Gym_Manager_Prologue/

Now you can open your own Gym and run the business as you fit. This is just a small part of what awaits you in the full version of the game. 

We are looking forward to your opinions, feedback and ideas, which are crucial in the further development of the full version of the game. We really count on your feedback, you can do it on Community Hub or on our Discord server (links are available below 👇).

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2902070/discussions/]📖- Prologue Bugs & Feedbacks[/url]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/WvBG3Bjrbv]💬 - Our Discord Server[/url]

[previewyoutube=LPMNjJQkOWk;full][/previewyoutube]

Have fun! 
Gym Manager Team 😊
